basic_details.job_title: ERNET India Registrar & CPO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: ERNET India (an autonomous scientific society under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Govt. of India) intends to fill the post of Registrar & CPO in Pay Matrix Level-13 (7th CPC) on deputation basis for three years. Eligible officers must send the Annexure-I application through proper channel to Block-1, A-Wing, 5th Floor, DMRC IT Park, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053, so that it reaches by 23 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The notice does not print a minimum age. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

how_to_apply: The application is sent on paper through proper channel. It must reach the Registrar & Director (P&A), ERNET India, Block-1, A-Wing, 5th Floor, DMRC IT Park, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053, within 30 days of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. The advertisement was published on 24 October 2026 (EN No. 30/90), so the last date for receipt is 23 November 2026.
Fill the prescribed Performa (Annexure-I), which carries the application for the post of Registrar & CPO on "Deputation basis" against Advt. No. EI-D-PA001/2/2026-PA dated 24.10.2026.
Serving Central Govt./State Govt./PSU/Autonomous body staff get the form certified by the present employer in the section at the end of Annexure-I.
Forward the application through proper channel; only applications received through proper channel will be considered.
If the application through proper channel is likely to be delayed, send an advance copy separately within the same period.
Attested APARs/ACRs for the last five years.
Vigilance Clearance Certificate and Disciplinary Clearance/Integrity Certificate, as applicable.
Latest copy of Aadhar Card/PAN card for identification.
Recent passport size photo, affixed on the form.
Additional information in support of suitability, on a separate sheet if necessary (optional item 11 of the form).

content_sections.heading: ERNET India Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the pay in rupees, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Pay Matrix Level-13 (as per the 7th CPC)
Deputation for a period of three years
Working on an analogous post on regular basis, or in Pay Matrix Level-12 with 5 years regular service in the grade and equivalent field
Annexure-I form forwarded through proper channel by post to the address in the circular
23 November 2026 (applications must reach by this date)

content_sections.heading: About ERNET India
content_sections.text: ERNET India is described in its circular as an autonomous scientific society under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Govt. of India. Its office is at Block-1, A-Wing, 5th Floor, DMRC IT Park, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053. The circular is signed by the Registrar & Director (P&A).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers who meet one of the two service conditions below, and whose services can be spared immediately upon selection, may apply. A person working on analogous posts in Govt/ PSUs/ Autonomous bodies on regular basis; OR A person working in Pay Matrix Level-12 (as per 7th CPC) and having 5 years regular service in the grade and equivalent field. Essential qualification: Graduate. PG Diploma in Personnel/Finance and experience in the field of Personnel/Administration. The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The notice does not print a minimum age. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post is in Pay Matrix Level-13 (as per the 7th CPC) on deputation basis for a period of three years. The period of deputation, including any deputation held against another ex-cadre post immediately preceding this appointment in the same or any other organisation, shall ordinarily not exceed five years, subject to the applicable Recruitment Rules and Government instructions. The pay and other terms and conditions of deputation are governed by the applicable instructions issued by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), including O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time, wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ERNET India Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed Performa (Annexure-I), which carries the application for the post of Registrar & CPO on "Deputation basis" against Advt. No. EI-D-PA001/2/2026-PA dated 24.10.2026. Serving Central Govt./State Govt./PSU/Autonomous body staff get the form certified by the present employer in the section at the end of Annexure-I. Forward the application through proper channel; only applications received through proper channel will be considered. If the application through proper channel is likely to be delayed, send an advance copy separately within the same period. Attested APARs/ACRs for the last five years. Vigilance Clearance Certificate and Disciplinary Clearance/Integrity Certificate, as applicable. Latest copy of Aadhar Card/PAN card for identification. Latest and updated Resume/CV. Recent passport size photo, affixed on the form. Additional information in support of suitability, on a separate sheet if necessary (optional item 11 of the form).

faq.question: Q1. What post has ERNET India advertised?
faq.answer: ERNET India intends to fill the post of Registrar & CPO in Pay Matrix Level-13 (7th CPC) on deputation basis. The number of posts is not printed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 23 November 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ERNET India Registrar & CPO post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Graduate. A PG Diploma in Personnel/Finance and experience in the field of Personnel/Administration are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for deputation?
faq.answer: A person working on analogous posts in Govt/PSUs/Autonomous bodies on regular basis, or a person in Pay Matrix Level-12 with 5 years regular service in the grade and equivalent field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for the post?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Matrix Level-13 (7th CPC). Pay and other terms of deputation are governed by applicable DoPT instructions, including O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill Annexure-I and forward it through proper channel to the Registrar & Director (P&A), ERNET India, Block-1, A-Wing, 5th Floor, DMRC IT Park, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053, with the documents named in the notice, so that it reaches by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. For how long is the deputation?
faq.answer: The deputation is for three years. Including any preceding ex-cadre deputation, the period shall ordinarily not exceed five years, subject to the applicable rules and instructions.

faq.question: Q9. Can an application be sent in advance if the proper channel is delayed?
faq.answer: Yes, an advance copy may be sent separately within the same period if the application through proper channel is likely to be delayed. Only applications received through proper channel will be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Can an applicant withdraw the candidature later?
faq.answer: No, officers who apply for the post shall not be permitted to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
